anti_patterns_to_avoid: NO purple-blue gradients, glowing orbs, floating blobs, or neon glassmorphism
NO repetitive 3-column rounded card grid in every section
NO center-everything disease (use editorial left-alignment and asymmetrical tension)
NO generic stock photos or fake client logos/awards
NO standard 'Icon + 3 lines of copy' repeated cards for capabilities
NO transparent dropdowns or unbordered sticky navs
NO Inter font for headlines - use Plus Jakarta Sans and Newsreader Serif for intentional moments

layout_and_spacing.spacing_philosophy: Generous 2x-3x editorial padding with intentional contrast between light and dark content sections

selected_work.note: All projects clearly tagged 'Concept Project'. Built as high-density hand-crafted HTML/CSS UI mockups.

concept_projects.title: Velox Fleet OS
concept_projects.problem: Legacy car rental operators struggle with fragmented reservation logs, manual vehicle check-ins, and inaccurate telemetry.
concept_projects.solution: An integrated fleet control center combining real-time GPS tracking, automated contract generation, and dynamic yield pricing.
concept_projects.ui_mockup_type: Fleet Dispatch Command Console with live map pins, status badges, vehicle utilization gauge, and quick action bar.

concept_projects.title: Strata Expedition
concept_projects.problem: High-end expedition operators suffer from drop-offs due to multi-step quote requests and complex itinerary management.
concept_projects.solution: An editorial booking interface allowing custom day-by-day itinerary assembly with instant seat availability checking.
concept_projects.ui_mockup_type: Itinerary Builder & Availability Matrix UI with interactive calendar, passenger capacity bars, and tier switcher.

concept_projects.title: Haven Property Hub
concept_projects.problem: Commercial property managers use disconnected channels for tenant communication, maintenance requests, and rent ledgers.
concept_projects.solution: A consolidated tenant & asset manager with automated dispatch for work orders and financial reporting.
concept_projects.ui_mockup_type: Asset Portfolio Manager UI displaying building occupancy cards, pending maintenance tickets, and revenue chart.

concept_projects.title: GastroFlow Kitchen
concept_projects.problem: Busy multi-location dining groups deal with kitchen ticket bottlenecks, food waste, and poor table turnover visibility.
concept_projects.solution: A high-speed Kitchen Display System (KDS) synchronized with floor management and digital menu ordering.
concept_projects.ui_mockup_type: KDS & Live Table Grid showing order timers (prep status: prep, fire, served), table layout grid, and item velocity.

concept_projects.title: Nexus Supply Chain
concept_projects.problem: Wholesale distributors lose revenue due to stockouts, manual purchase order entry, and lack of real-time inventory visibility.
concept_projects.solution: An automated inventory engine tracking SKU stock across multiple warehouses with predictive reorder triggers.
concept_projects.ui_mockup_type: Inventory Dashboard UI with stock alert badges, SKU search table, reorder trigger sliders, and margin breakdown.

concept_projects.title: Aura Privé
concept_projects.problem: Luxury D2C brands fail to retain high-net-worth customers with generic point-reward plugins.
concept_projects.solution: A bespoke membership portal featuring tier-based benefits, digital privilege cards, and personalized event invitations.
concept_projects.ui_mockup_type: VIP Membership Portal UI featuring member tier card, reward points timeline, and exclusive perk unlock drawer.

We approach engineering with architectural discipline: understand the real workflow, design the right solution, write maintainable code, and deliver measurable business leverage.

items.question: How does Alpha One Studio structure project engagements?
items.answer: We work primarily on fixed-scope project milestones or dedicated engineering sprints, depending on project clarity and timeline flexibility.

items.question: Do you offer post-launch support and maintenance?
items.answer: Yes. We offer continuous modernization, security updates, feature enhancements, and service level agreements (SLAs) post-deployment.

items.question: Who owns the code and intellectual property?
items.answer: You retain complete ownership of all code, assets, database schemas, and documentation. Everything is delivered via private Git repositories.

items.question: What technologies do you specialize in?
items.answer: We specialize in React, Node.js/Python FastAPI backend systems, PostgreSQL/Redis data layers, cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP), and modern API architectures.

items.question: How do we get started with a project discussion?
items.answer: Simply submit a project inquiry through our contact form or message us directly via WhatsApp to arrange an initial technical discovery session.
